statement: Let n = len(nums). The function returns a result r, and r is determined as follows. (1) If k = 0, then r = nums[0]. (2) Otherwise, if n = 1, then r = nums[0] when k is even, and r = -1 when k is odd. (3) Otherwise n >= 2: (a) if k < n, then r is the largest value in the set { nums[i] | 0 <= i <= k-2 } union { nums[k] }, with the first set empty when k = 1; (b) if k = n, then r is the largest value among nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[n-2]; (c) if k > n, then r is the largest value among nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[n-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r; in particular, it does not fail, panic, or overflow on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that r = nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, 0 <= r <= max_{0 <= i < len(nums)} nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1 if and only if len(nums) = 1 and k is odd.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns r and r >= nums[k].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; let n = len(nums); n >= 2; 1 <= k < n.

statement: The function returns r and, for every i with 0 <= i <= k-2, r >= nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5; 0 <= k <= 10^9; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; let n = len(nums); n >= 2; 2 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever maximum_top nums k returns r and maximum_top nums' k returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: Both nums and nums' satisfy 1 <= len <= 10^5 and all entries are between 0 and 10^9; 0 <= k <= 10^9; 0 <= k < len(nums); 0 <= k < len(nums'); for every i with 0 <= i <= k, nums[i] = nums'[i].
